scope: Always-emitted infrastructure verdict and independent skip authorization
scenarios: Clean documentation-only commit plus successful selector and skipped infrastructure produces not-applicable.
Failed, cancelled, missing and unexpectedly skipped selector results fail.
Unavailable base evidence requires full coverage.
Skipped runtime changes and explicitly requested full coverage fail.
Scheduled full coverage accepts the intentionally skipped selector.
Independent required inventory, candidate source and raw shard reconciliation remain enforced.
limitations: Local actual Git/Vitest behavioral test and workflow syntax validation; not current native CI execution.
Other workflow/global prerequisite gates and effective GitHub required protections remain open.
